<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Act as a Playwright test generator. Extend the existing add-to-cart.spec.ts test case, which already scripts the flow up to adding the product to the cart and generating the order ID. Add steps to track the order using the generated ID, then assert that the product in the cart matches the order product.
